Tsup.standard_reference: SN EN 14511-3:2022 Table 6, Interval H - Arithmetical mean

dTreturn.description: Return temperature difference band (transient): dTreturn = T_return_emu − T_return_calc

Tmean.description: Mean water temperature: cycle mean of T_mean_log against the ecodesign Table 3 mean. Variable-flow tests only — fixed-flow tests run above the Table 3 mean at part load by physics, so they are judged on Tsup instead. No transient band is defined.
Tmean.standard_reference: BAM lab proposal — the ecodesign draft defines no tolerance for the mean temperature. 0.5 K chosen as the analogue of SN EN 14511-3:2022 Table 6 Interval H (mean supply temperature).
